written: 2026-10-01, for the IUVA 2026 deck's Sozzi slides (2, 3, 9, 10, 15)

mesh.what: uvmesh, the deck's data/uvmesh/mesh.py (prod_lowre5) with OOR's tutorials/uvReactorSozzi2006/SozziTaghipour.step
mesh.uvmesh: OOR 276d992 (tools/uvMesh 0.12.0, PR #84), built from its working tree on 2026-09-30
mesh.first_cell: 20 um at the lamp sleeve (structured lamp layer), 100 um at the chamber wall (wall layer), joined non-conformally to a polyhedral bulk

flow.solver: foamRun incompressibleFluid, PIMPLE with local time stepping (the tutorial's fvSolution: nCorrectors 2, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 2, maxCo 1)
flow.stopped: PIMPLE solution converged in 2059 iterations (residualControl U 5e-4, p 1e-3, k and omega 1e-4)
flow.code: the case's dictionaries are OOR tutorials/uvReactorSozzi2006 (659ec4a) with SST; set up in aquaflux branch claude/sozzi-consistent-set (head 0d5c7b56, unmerged, with uncommitted changes); no committed script writes this case, so its dictionaries are copied into the deck's records

fluence_rates.line source: setFluenceRate -xStart 0 -xEnd 0.80 (OOR 659ec4a build in lib/ and bin/), case/uv_arc
fluence_rates.DOM 64: case/uv_dom_lu: 64 directions (8 x 4), 1 x 1 pixels, bounded Gauss linearUpwind rays, convergence 1e-5 (15 sweeps), 8 ranks, 293 s; OOR 659ec4a
fluence_rates.DOM 256: case/uv_dom256_lu: 256 directions (16 x 8), otherwise as DOM 64; 15 sweeps, 1037 s; OOR 659ec4a
fluence_rates.lamp: diffuseEmitter on lamp0_wall and lamp0_tip_B, M = 696.42 W/m2; absorption 35.67 1/m; every other wall black

tracker.code: OOR b23582b (PR #90: the langevin dispersion model with one integrator for every step and a continuous step; on main 256b449 = #88 + #89), built into lib_b23582b (run_lgvB.sh, 2026-10-02). The first deck set used ebadf6e (the zone-switch model); its swap results are in swap_ebadf6e/
tracker.settings: the tutorial's postProcess.dict: patchInjection on inlet, 10000 requested (9987 seeded), seed 42, dtMax 5 ms, cflMax 0.5, maxTime 300 s, wallReflection true, kInact (0.1); dispersion { type langevin; omega omega; Cmu 0.09; Cl 0.15 } (maxStepFraction 0.02, minLagrangianTime 1e-2 s, defaults); motion tracer
tracker.threads: 1 OpenMP thread (the walk depends on the thread count)
tracker.cases: line source case/uv_arc_lgvB; slide 10 DOM (64 directions, its own patch values, VTK tracks every 10 steps) case/slide10_dom_lu_B; swap set swap/{aquaflux,dom64,dom256,dom256_native}
